key_result: Austrian providers intermediate roughly 30 billion dollars in cumulative external transfers; retail-like and institutional flows respond differently around stress events such as the FTX bankruptcy.
takeaway: Uses a regulatory registry of the onchain addresses of every crypto-asset service provider in Austria to trace their Bitcoin, Ether, USDT and USDC flows.
title: Stablecoin Integration and Stress Transmission Through Crypto-Asset Service Providers: Evidence from Austria
why_it_matters: Direct identification of providers replaces the indirect proxies most stablecoin studies rely on.
